title: Fail-closed on disconnect / stale / missing-rank / stale-generation
hypothesis: Coordinator loss, stale telemetry, incomplete reports, and replayed/stale generations all stop expansion and (where relevant) tighten admission, without evicting running requests or advancing state off a stale input.
expectation: a: disconnect->0 & retain running; b: STALE decrease; c: incomplete held then decreased, never NORMAL; d: old/equal/stale-report generations rejected; e: KV guard keeps channel live.

checks.name: a: disconnect -> cap 0, DISCONNECTED, 5 running retained, no new admission
b: stale report -> STALE decisions, cap monotonically non-increasing, telemetry_health source
c: first incomplete report(s) are HELD for missing_report_grace_samples
c: a further incomplete report DECREASES the cap (never expands, never 'low pressure')
c: no incomplete step is ever NORMAL or increases the cap
d: older / equal decision generation and stale report generation are all rejected
e: local KV guard tightens immediately and does not block the next coordinator decision

analysis:
MATCHES EXPECTATION on all five fault paths.
(a) apply_dynamic_hbm_disconnect_guard takes min(current_safety_cap, disconnect_admission_cap)=0 and sets DISCONNECTED; the execution budget still equals the running count, so the 5 in-flight requests are not evicted, but _dynamic_hbm_allows_new_admission() is False. This is a purely local action - it fires without any message from the (now gone) coordinator.
(b) _check_memory_report_timeouts_locked, once report age exceeds report_timeout_ms, synthesises a report with an EMPTY rank tuple and runs it through the same BudgetAllocator; the empty-rank path multiplicatively decreases the cap, and the wire decision is tagged safety_state=stale, reason=stale_report_*, pressure_source=telemetry_health. Expansion is impossible while stale.
(c) In BudgetAllocator the incomplete branch holds the cap for missing_report_grace_samples (state=incomplete) then multiplicatively decreases (state=stale, reason=incomplete_rank_reports_decrease). No incomplete report can reach the low-pressure branch, so a half-missing report can never be mistaken for headroom and can never expand the cap.
(d) apply_stage_budget_decision rejects any decision whose generation <= the last applied generation, and any decision whose based_on_report_generation < the last report generation. An older replay, an equal-generation replay, and a decision built on a stale report are all dropped, leaving the last good cap (8) intact.
(e) apply_dynamic_hbm_local_kv_guard tightens to critical_admission_cap immediately WITHOUT advancing _last_budget_generation, so the next genuine coordinator decision (generation 8) still applies and reconciles the replica. Fail-closed here does not wedge the control channel.
Across all paths the invariant holds: faults stop expansion and (where visibility is lost) tighten admission, but never kill running work and never let a stale input drive state.
